Installing uv

uv provides a standalone installer that downloads the latest release and puts it on your path. It works on macOS and Linux and does not require Python to be installed first.

Use curl to download the script and execute it with sh:

$ curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

If your system does not have curl, you can use wget instead, which behaves the same way and also pipes the installer straight into your shell for a one-step setup.

$ wget -qO- https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
